en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neo‑Gothic/neo‑Romanesque school building with an attached church or chapel and prominent tower. In the foreground a group of uniformed boys or scouts march in formation along the street. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Pécs and the institution as the Pius Gymnasium. The reverse side is a typical divided postcard back with Hungarian text, printer's mark, and a note about postage.
